pages.title: Doffing the Hat
pages.text: Koishi would have struck at a guest, but the attempt bore no fruit; three times was one time too many, and in her fury she threw the hat aside and walked off.

While worn$(br)Grants Unconscious, so hostile mobs will not pick you as a target — the moment you attack something yourself or open a container, it is gone.$(br2)How to block$(br2)During Marisa's Nether quest, the player hears ringing down there; after the third telephone ring ends, raise a shield behind you and block. A successful block scores one count, a single failure resets it to zero, and reaching the number gives you the hat.
